hints.title: Element Index Inversion
hints.text: Record the index positions where each element appears in the second sequence.

hints.title: Grouping Duplicate Occurrences
hints.text: Map each unique value to a list of its indices in the second sequence.

hints.title: Retrieval by Mapping
hints.text: For every element in the first sequence, retrieve and consume an available index from the recorded occurrences.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Linear scan to build index lookup dictionary followed by constant-time lookups.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching nums2 for each item in nums1 takes O(N^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: An inverted index map uses O(N) extra space to deliver O(1) retrieval per element.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Support potential duplicates by tracking a list of indices per value.
